}}{{TIDTOC|embedded}} ==Overview== *"Model:CDF21L1", "P/N:08-06CDF2112" and "Ver 1.2" are silkscreened on the board. {{See also|Synology DiskStation Devices|List of NAS Devices}}
*This is a 2-bay NAS. It would appear to have 2x USB 3.0 and 1x USB 2.0 ports. :CPU: [[Freescale#Network Processors|Freescale]] P1022 (''QorIQ'') Dual Core @1.06GHz
===Hardware specification=== *CPU: [[Freescale (NXP)]] P1022 @1.06GHz :Dual-core ''Power'' architecture (e500v2) *Memory: 512MB (DDR3) SDRAM ([[Samsung]]) *Storage: Storage: 8MB (SPI NOR) Flash, :2x SATA ports, 1x eSATA port :SD Card slot *Network: 1x Gigabit Ethernet port *USB: 1x USB 2.0, 2x USB 3.0 ports *Power: 12V, 5.4A via barrel
